callees.name: _strip_star
callees.pre_condition: d is a dict whose string keys may carry a leading '*' prefix from streaming-delta decorators.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict with the same key-value pairs as d, except that any leading '*' character in a string key is removed.

callees.name: _parse_iso
callees.pre_condition: ts is a string value extracted from the rec dict's timestamp field, or None if the field was absent or falsy.
callees.post_condition: Returns a parsed datetime value if ts is a valid ISO 8601 timestamp string. Returns None if ts is None or cannot be parsed as a valid timestamp.

callees.name: _trace_value
callees.pre_condition: d is a dict derived from a raw trace record. keys is a sequence of string field names to probe in order.
callees.post_condition: Returns the value of the first key in keys for which d has a truthy value. Returns None if none of the keys are present or all have falsy values.

callees.name: _get_nested
callees.pre_condition: d is a dict. keys is a sequence of string field names forming a nested key path.
callees.post_condition: Returns the value at the nested path specified by keys within d. Returns None if any intermediate key in the path is missing.

callees.name: _cost_from_usage
callees.pre_condition: model is a string model identifier or None. usage is a dict containing token-count fields reflecting a single LLM request's consumption.
callees.post_condition: Returns the monetary cost in dollars for the given model and token counts. Returns 0.0 if model is None or unrecognized.

callees.name: _push_llm_status
callees.signature: _push_llm_status(self, ts, source, label, status, model, code, detail)
callees.pre_condition: ts is a datetime or None. source is the string 'opencode'. label, status, model, code, and detail are strings describing the LLM call outcome.
callees.post_condition: A new entry is appended to self's in-memory LLM-status timeline, recording the timestamp, source, label, status, model, status code, and detail. Entries are appended in call order.
